summary: Planet Labs PBC filed an 8-K to report entering into an Equity Distribution Agreement. The agreement establishes an at-the-market offering program for up to $1.5 billion of Class A common stock, with multiple sales agents and forward purchasers. Shares may be sold through agents or pursuant to forward sale agreements involving hedging transactions. This is a routine equity shelf facility, not a special situation event. The filing discloses material terms of a capital-raising arrangement, not a transformative corporate transaction.
